instruction: Design a module that combines two D flip-flops with active high synchronous reset and a control logic module that selects which flip-flop to use. The flip-flops should be reset to 0x34 rather than zero. The module should have two input ports for data signals and one input port for the clock signal. The output port should provide a signal that is the result of the selected data signal being delayed by one clock cycle.
label: trojan
